title: Deal Board
tagline: Back made-up companies. Read their signals. Learn when to hold and when to walk away.
intro: You have ₹1,00,000 of play money and 12 turns. Each turn is one quarter of a year.
Roll the die and move around the board. Tiles bring pitches, news, rumours and bills.
The game scores your judgement, not your profit. A careful choice can still lose to bad luck.
guardrail: Simulation with made-up numbers. Real life is different.
dragNote: Prices rose a little. Idle cash lost {{x}}.

news.label: Market news
news.quiet: A quiet quarter. Nothing big moves the market.
news.slowdown: A broad slowdown hits every sector.
news.shaky: Markets stay shaky after the slowdown.

start.name: Start
start.body: Know where you stand. Cash {{cash}}, net worth {{nw}}.

bank.name: Bank
bank.body: The Banker can give you one clue or a small loan. The Banker's desk opens in the next update.

rent.name: Rent Day
rent.body: Every company you own pays this quarter's rent: its profit.
rent.empty: You do not own any companies yet, so no rent arrives.

tax.name: Tax
tax.body: Fees paid so far: {{fees}}. Every buy and every sell costs 1%.

parking.name: Free Parking

chest.name: Community Chest
chest.body: A chest of family news. A cushion of cash is what makes bad news easier to handle.
chest.warn: A family emergency arrives at the end of this quarter. Be ready.

closing: Real markets are harder than this game. This teaches how to ask good questions, not what to buy.
